_comment: Copy to config/oidc-group-map.json (or point OIDC_GROUP_MAP_PATH at it) to
let the customer's IdP drive Citra department membership. The file EXISTING
is what enables the feature; delete it to fall back to zero-access JIT where
an admin grants each user a dept by hand.
'claim' is the ID-token claim holding the officer's groups. Dotted paths are
supported for IdPs that nest them (Keycloak: 'realm_access.roles').
Entra ID emits 'groups' as object IDs unless group-name emission is turned on
in the app registration — check a real token before writing this file.
Every dept_id must exist in config/depts.seed.json; the service refuses to
start otherwise. Roles are optional and additive; 'super_admin' is rejected.
Groups below are the acme-bank demo shape — replace with the customer's.
